# fastboot-info for lineage_grizzly
# Static because vendor_kernel_boot is a stock prebuilt, so the generated file leaves it out.
version 1
flash boot
flash init_boot
flash dtbo
flash pvmfw
flash vendor_boot
flash vendor_kernel_boot
flash --apply-vbmeta vbmeta
flash vbmeta_system
flash vbmeta_vendor
reboot fastboot
update-super
flash system
flash system_dlkm
flash system_ext
flash product
flash vendor
flash vendor_dlkm
flash --slot-other system system_other.img
if-wipe erase userdata
if-wipe erase metadata
